card.name: Dose or frequency after single/reduce the
card.fires_on: The noun right after a dosing-adjustment word, mostly "dose" after "single" and "frequency" after "reduce the". It also fires on "weekly" after "twice" and "body" after "from the".

modes.label: Single dose
modes.description: "dose" right after "single" in directions on how a drug is given.

modes.label: Reduce the frequency
modes.description: "frequency" after "reduce the" in advice on adjusting application.
modes.example: instruct patients to use a moisturizer, reduce the<< frequency>> of the application of CABTREO

modes.label: Twice weekly
modes.description: "weekly" after "twice" when dosing frequency is raised.
modes.example: Increase frequency to twice<< weekly>> if there is inadequate improvement in TA-T
